market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $100+ oil, rate-hike fears, and US-Canada trade escalation. Expect elevated volatility (VIX likely 20+). Energy and defense outperform; growth and consumer discretionary lag. Apple iPhone event adds near-term catalyst. Dow futures already dipping. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, risk-off bias with oil as primary driver.
market_outlook.long_term: If US-Iran conflict de-escalates, oil normalizes and rate pressure eases, supporting a recovery in equities. AI capex cycle (Amazon $200B) provides structural growth. Fintech consolidation and space sector expansion offer multi-year themes. However, persistent inflation (47% insurance, 6.85% mortgages) and trade wars cap upside. 6-12 month outlook: cautious recovery contingent on geopolitical resolution.
